sql:
SELECT
    toMonth(DateKey) AS MonthNumber,
    formatDateTime(DateKey, '%B') AS MonthName,
    sum(SalesAmount - TotalCost) AS GrossMarginDollars,
    round(sum(SalesAmount - TotalCost) / sum(SalesAmount) * 100, 2) AS GrossMarginPct
FROM retail.FactOnlineSales
WHERE toYear(DateKey) = 2009
GROUP BY MonthNumber, MonthName
ORDER BY MonthNumber
